summary: VIAVI SOLUTIONS INC. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) on May 19, 2026, to offer $500 million of common stock in an underwritten public offering. The shares trade on Nasdaq under VIAV; closing price on May 18, 2026 was $49.75. Underwriters have a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional $75 million in shares. This is a routine shelf takedown by a well-known seasoned issuer, not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event. It is an ordinary equity capital markets transaction.
